# Casberi

> Your life and money are scattered across apps. Casberi gives you an inbox and a wallet for all your accounts: keep up with your feeds and finances in one place. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no Casberi account, and read on your device.

Key facts:

- Free on the App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- More than 100 apps connect, among them Gmail, iCloud Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Photos, Apple Health, Apple Wallet, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Notion, Slack, Trello, Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, App Store Connect, Readwise, RSS, Substack, YouTube, Spotify, Bluesky, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Gemini.
- Five tabs: Feed is what's happening, Wallet is what you have, Move is what you do with it, Library is your apps and you, and Search finds anything. On iPad and Mac the same five run down a rail.
- Feed: every app together, in seven sections — Day, Notes, Social, Work, Media, Life and Agents — each holding today's rows, one row per app. Tap a section for the whole category, or an app for that app alone.
- Wallet: one balance across self-custody accounts (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, World Chain, HyperEVM, Monad, Robinhood Chain, Tempo, Solana, Bitcoin and Lightning), Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and Gemini, ETH validators, and Wise and Apple Wallet cash. Its pages: Home (your balance, then Account, Needs you, Permissions and Threats), Activity, Holdings and Spending (subscriptions, places, fees and round-ups). Following an account is read-only: you paste an address or a name, never a seed phrase, and it can never move funds.
- Move: an account of your own (a Safe on Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain, no seed phrase) and five verbs, each approved with Face ID: Buy a gift card, Receive, Send, Swap and Sweep. Swaps go straight to Uniswap and Aerodrome from the phone, through Tor; a swap to another network crosses through Across. Sweep turns every token under $1 or $5 on a network into ETH in one transaction. Sends, swaps and gift cards can round up, the change buying a token you pick.
- Library: Casberi's settings, then every app you have by category, and eight counts — Apps, Calendars, Cards, Contacts, Mail lists, Media, Subscriptions and Wallet.
- Subscriptions are found on their own from your cards, Apple Wallet and Rocket Money; what they cost lives in the Wallet's Spending.
- Testnets: the Logos testnet and the Aztec testnet and its sequencers, with test coins only.
- Agents: read what the agents you use did, in one place. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others with your own key, kept in the Keychain and sent from the device straight to that provider; your own OpenAI-compatible server; or Apple Intelligence with no key.
- Notes and voice notes, Contacts across your accounts, and share cards. Widgets for your notes, your wallet and your feed.
- No Casberi account, no server, no analytics. Every request that names a wallet goes through Tor on iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync is opt-in. Export, import and delete-everything are real controls.
